Mixed Response Derivatives of a Zero-Adjusted Continuous Family

Source: R/zero_wrapper_dexpected.R
za_y_list.Rd

Evaluates a mixed derivative in the response and the parameters, distrib_cross_y(), distrib_cross2_y() or distrib_cross3_y(), for zero_adjusted() over a continuous parent. Away from the atom the components of the parent's parameters are the parent's, and the component of za is zero, since za enters the log-density only through \(\log(1 - \pi)\). At the atom every component is NaN, as for za_y_deriv(). The same guard is registered for distrib_deriv3_y() and distrib_deriv4_y() through za_y_deriv().

Usage

za_y_list(distrib, y, theta, fun)

Arguments

distrib

A ZeroAdjustedContinuousDistrib object.

y

A numeric vector of observations.

theta

A named list with the parent's parameters followed by za.

fun

The generic to evaluate on the parent.

Value

A named list keyed by distrib@params, one numeric vector per parameter, each as long as y.

See also

za_y_deriv() for the response derivatives.

Examples

d <- zero_adjusted(gaussian1_distrib())
distributions7:::za_y_list(d, c(-1, 0, 2), list(mu = 1, sigma = 2, za = 0.3),
                           distrib_cross_y)
#> $mu
#> [1] 0.25  NaN 0.25
#> 
#> $sigma
#> [1] -0.50   NaN  0.25
#> 
#> $za
#> [1]   0 NaN   0
#>
